title: PKI Suite samples catalog
description: One entry per (task, language, framework). The task slug is `id` minus its trailing `-<product>`.

id.description: Kebab-case slug, identical in every language. Must end with `-<product>`.

title.description: Short human-readable name of the task.

title_pt.description: The same name in Brazilian Portuguese, which the Portuguese pages of docs.lacunasoftware.com show. Entries that share an `id` share their `title_pt`.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the sample does, taken from the code where possible.

product.description: The PKI Suite product that does the server-side work.

path.description: Repo-relative path, with forward slashes, to the main entry file (controller, route module or page).

related_files.description: Repo-relative paths of the other files needed to understand the sample (views, page scripts, models, helpers).

status.description: current: recommended for new work. legacy: works, but prefer the current alternative. deprecated: do not copy.

demo_url.description: Matching task on the demo site, or null when there is none.

run.description: How to start the project that contains this sample and where to open it.

cwd.description: Repo-relative project folder to run `command` from.

command.description: The one command that starts the project.

url.description: URL to open once the project is running, or null for a console project.
